explication: HelixDB is a graph database with transactional graph queries, vector search, and BM25 full-text search. A typical workflow is to build a query with an SDK or CLI, send it to a running instance, execute it through the query service and interpreter, and receive results. The planner and index lifecycle provide important internal layers. Relationships below are limited to README statements and sampled-source references; unsampled subsystem connections are omitted.
